subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): generic outbound delivery-report seam; WhatsApp native auto-reply reports provider-accepted sends

question: Should OpenClaw accept `openclaw/plugin-sdk/outbound-delivery-report` as the public contract for channel self-delivered sends before release?
rationale: The code path is plausible, but the new SDK subpath name, semantics, and idempotency behavior become compatibility commitments once shipped.

options.title: Approve Seam After Proof
options.body: Require redacted WhatsApp/runtime proof and then accept this generic report seam as the supported public API.

options.title: Narrow Or Rename Contract
options.body: Keep the bug fix direction but ask for API shape changes before the subpath ships.

options.title: Pause Public API
options.body: Leave the linked issue open and defer this PR if maintainers are not ready to own a new plugin SDK contract.

recommendation.title: Approve Seam After Proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted WhatsApp/runtime proof and then accept this generic report seam as the supported public API.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the adjacent outbound hook contract PR and recent sibling sent-hook parity work, so he is the best routing candidate for the public API decision.
